finite_sublemmas.name: FOUR_COORDINATE_FOUR_MASK_SEPARATION
finite_sublemmas.statement: For any four distinct masks in {-1,0,+1}^4, at most 11 nonzero q tails are simultaneously compatible with all four and make the four coordinatewise unions pairwise distinct.
finite_sublemmas.verification: Exhaustive deterministic branch-and-bound over all 81 masks and 80 nonzero q tails; pruning is only by exact intersection cardinality and cannot remove a better witness.

finite_sublemmas.name: FOUR_COORDINATE_FIVE_MASK_SEPARATION
finite_sublemmas.statement: For any five distinct masks in {-1,0,+1}^4, at most 8 nonzero q tails are simultaneously compatible with all five and make the five coordinatewise unions pairwise distinct.

proof: As in the clean-core family, K>=637 yields an injective non-tautological representative set G of t=637-c new resolvents, with at most B=p*q-t bad cross pairs. Since t>486, G contains both signs of every nonpivot coordinate, and clean row/column supports are disjoint.
For the listed transitions the smaller clean core P0 has size at least 8 and Q0 at least 9. Thus P0 needs at least two active coordinates and Q0 at least three.

If P0 uses at least three coordinates, disjointness forces the familiar 3+3 split. Since |Q0|>=9, THREE_COORDINATE_TWO_MASK_SEPARATION makes the P projection onto its three coordinates injective. At most 18 P tails then contain any fixed P-side coordinate. The minimum parent occurrence d-c is 21 for c=29 and 19 for c=31, so an exceptional Q tail occurs on every P-side coordinate. Cleanliness of every P0 row forbids one sign on each of the three coordinates, leaving at most 2^3-1=7 nonempty P0 tails, contradicting |P0|>=8.

It remains that P0 is supported on exactly two coordinates A. Eight distinct nonempty ternary tails on two coordinates saturate the entire universe 3^2-1=8, so P0 contains both signs of each A coordinate. Because every P0 row is clean, every Q tail must omit both A coordinates.

Each A coordinate has total degree at least d=50 and can occur in at most c retained clauses, so it occurs in at least d-c P tails. Therefore at most p-(d-c) P tails omit each A coordinate. By the union bound, at least F=2(d-c)-p P tails contain both A coordinates.
There are only four fully nonzero sign patterns on A, so at least ceil(F/4) distinct P tails share one common A projection. For c=29,p=24 this gives ceil(18/4)=5; for c=31,p=23 it gives ceil(15/4)=4.

The tails are distinct, hence their masks on the remaining four coordinates are distinct. At most B bad edges exist globally, so these selected rows have at least q-B common Q neighbours belonging to G: 10 in the first transition and 12 in the second.

Every Q tail omits A, so each common neighbour is a nonzero four-coordinate q. Injectivity of G requires its unions with all selected P residual masks to be pairwise distinct. The exact finite sublemmas cap such q by 8 for five masks and 11 for four masks, contradicting 10 and 12 respectively.
Thus K>=637 is impossible in both transitions. Consequently K<=636, L_out<=2724 and raw storage<=3361<3364.
